# Topic A — First Plots & Aesthetics


## Q1 · L1 · Reference

**Goal:** Plot engine size (displ) against highway mpg (hwy) for the `mpg` data.

```{r q1-data, eval=TRUE}
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r q1-l1, eval=TRUE}
# === Complete example — read and run ===
p <- ggplot(data = mpg, mapping = aes(x = displ, y = hwy)) +
  geom_point()
p
nrow(mpg)          # each point is one car model
```

# Topic B — Distributions


## Q6 · L1 · Reference

**Goal:** Count cars by class.

```{r q6-data, eval=TRUE}
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r q6-l1, eval=TRUE}
# === Complete example — read and run ===
ggplot(mpg, aes(x = class)) + geom_bar()
counts <- table(mpg$class)
counts
ggplot(mpg, aes(x = factor(class, levels = names(sort(counts, decreasing = TRUE))))) +
  geom_bar() + labs(x = "class")                         # ordered by count
```

# Topic C — Relationships, Groups & Facets


## Q11 · L1 · Reference

**Goal:** Add a separate smoothed line for each drive type.

```{r q11-data, eval=TRUE}
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r q11-l1, eval=TRUE}
# === Complete example — read and run ===
ggplot(mpg, aes(displ, hwy, colour = drv)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE)
round(tapply(mpg$hwy, mpg$drv, mean), 2)
```

# Topic D — Communicating & Saving


## Q16 · L1 · Reference

**Goal:** Add a title, subtitle and caption, change the theme and save the plot with ggsave().

```{r q16-data, eval=TRUE}
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r q16-l1, eval=TRUE}
# === Complete example — read and run ===
p <- ggplot(mpg, aes(displ, hwy, colour = class)) + geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Fuel efficiency generally decreases with engine size",
       subtitle = "Two-seaters are an exception because they are light",
       caption = "Data: ggplot2::mpg", x = "Engine displacement (L)", y = "Highway mpg") +
  theme_minimal()
p
out <- file.path(tempdir(), "mpg_plot.png")
ggsave(out, p, width = 7, height = 4, dpi = 150)
file.exists(out)
```
